This is the continuous scene cue M05, using source offset 120.000 to 125.000 seconds; carry rhythm and reverb across clip boundaries without a fresh intro or end fade.

panels.attachmentLock: BEYBLADE-LAUNCHER ATTACHMENT LOCK: every loaded top sits level with its flat upper face directly flush against the canonical launcher underside, zero visible gap, conical tip straight down, and exactly two very short engagement prongs fully hidden inside the paired centre slots. Never show a long shaft, stem, axle, neck, string, cable, tether or floating gap between launcher and top. The ripcord is a separate short rigid toothed strip inserted horizontally through the launcher, with its ring in the pulling hand. When three owner sets are present, Kaiden alone holds the blue-red launcher and handmade brown-ring top, Nanao alone holds the green-black-yellow launcher and blue-red-yellow Dragoon, and Mocha alone holds the red-purple launcher and white-red-purple Driger; never swap, repeat or hybridize these pairs.
